[[fixture-git:CoupledFiles]]
[source,cypher,role=concept,requiresConcepts="fixture-git:ChurnPerFile, fixture-git:CommitsWithParents"]
.Pairs of files that change in the same commit.
----
MATCH (c:Commit)-[:CONTAINS_CHANGE]->(:Change)-[:MODIFIES]->(f1:File),
      (c)-[:CONTAINS_CHANGE]->(:Change)-[:MODIFIES]->(f2:File)
WHERE f1.path < f2.path
WITH f1, f2, count(DISTINCT c) AS together
WHERE together > 2
MERGE (f1)-[r:CHANGED_TOGETHER_WITH]-(f2)
SET r.count = together
----

[[fixture-git:Refactorings]]
[source,cypher,role=constraint,severity=CRITICAL,requiresConcepts="fixture-git:*"]
.Commits that touch more than fifty files.
----
MATCH (c:Commit)-[:CONTAINS_CHANGE]->(ch:Change)
WITH c, count(ch) AS files
WHERE files > 50
RETURN c.oid AS commit, files
----
